objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGAlign,
    YGAlignAuto,
    YGAlignFlexStart,
    YGAlignCenter,
    YGAlignFlexEnd,
    YGAlignStretch,
    YGAlignBaseline,
    YGAlignSpaceBetween,
    YGAlignSpaceAround,
    YGAlignSpaceEvenly)
objects.description: Enumeration of alignment options for Yoga layout (cross-axis/self alignment and distribution). Exact underlying enum syntax is generated via YG_ENUM_DECL macro; concrete integer values beyond ordering are unspecified here.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGBoxSizing,
    YGBoxSizingBorderBox,
    YGBoxSizingContentBox)
objects.description: Enumeration selecting how size calculations account for borders/padding: border-box vs content-box. Defined via macro expansion in Yoga.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGDimension,
    YGDimensionWidth,
    YGDimensionHeight)
objects.description: Enumeration for dimension axes: width or height. Used to index or refer to dimensional properties.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGDirection,
    YGDirectionInherit,
    YGDirectionLTR,
    YGDirectionRTL)
objects.description: Enumeration for layout direction: inherit from parent, left-to-right, or right-to-left.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGDisplay,
    YGDisplayFlex,
    YGDisplayNone,
    YGDisplayContents)
objects.description: Display behavior enumeration for nodes: flex, none, or contents (children participate without the node box).

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGEdge,
    YGEdgeLeft,
    YGEdgeTop,
    YGEdgeRight,
    YGEdgeBottom,
    YGEdgeStart,
    YGEdgeEnd,
    YGEdgeHorizontal,
    YGEdgeVertical,
    YGEdgeAll)
objects.description: Enumeration of edges used for margins, paddings, borders and insets, including compound edges (horizontal, vertical, all) and logical start/end.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGErrata,
    YGErrataNone = 0,
    YGErrataStretchFlexBasis = 1,
    YGErrataAbsolutePositionWithoutInsetsExcludesPadding = 2,
    YGErrataAbsolutePercentAgainstInnerSize = 4,
    YGErrataAll = 2147483647,
    YGErrataClassic = 2147483646)
YG_DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG_OPERATORS(YGErrata)
objects.description: Bitflag enumeration for known behavioral errata/toggles in Yoga’s layout engine. Operators are defined to allow bitwise combination via YG_DEFINE_ENUM_FLAG_OPERATORS.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGExperimentalFeature,
    YGExperimentalFeatureWebFlexBasis)
objects.description: Enumeration of experimental feature flags; currently includes WebFlexBasis behavior toggle.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGFlexDirection,
    YGFlexDirectionColumn,
    YGFlexDirectionColumnReverse,
    YGFlexDirectionRow,
    YGFlexDirectionRowReverse)
objects.description: Enumeration specifying the main-axis direction for flex layout, including reversed variants.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGGutter,
    YGGutterColumn,
    YGGutterRow,
    YGGutterAll)
objects.description: Enumeration of gutters (spacing between items) by axis or all.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGJustify,
    YGJustifyFlexStart,
    YGJustifyCenter,
    YGJustifyFlexEnd,
    YGJustifySpaceBetween,
    YGJustifySpaceAround,
    YGJustifySpaceEvenly)
objects.description: Enumeration for distribution of items along the main axis (justify-content).

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGLogLevel,
    YGLogLevelError,
    YGLogLevelWarn,
    YGLogLevelInfo,
    YGLogLevelDebug,
    YGLogLevelVerbose,
    YGLogLevelFatal)
objects.description: Enumeration of logging severity levels used by Yoga.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGMeasureMode,
    YGMeasureModeUndefined,
    YGMeasureModeExactly,
    YGMeasureModeAtMost)
objects.description: Enumeration of measurement modes passed to measure functions: undefined, exactly, or at-most constraints.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGNodeType,
    YGNodeTypeDefault,
    YGNodeTypeText)
objects.description: Enumeration marking node type: default element or special text node.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGOverflow,
    YGOverflowVisible,
    YGOverflowHidden,
    YGOverflowScroll)
objects.description: Enumeration controlling overflow behavior along both axes.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGPositionType,
    YGPositionTypeStatic,
    YGPositionTypeRelative,
    YGPositionTypeAbsolute)
objects.description: Enumeration of positioning schemes for Yoga nodes (static, relative, absolute).

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGUnit,
    YGUnitUndefined,
    YGUnitPoint,
    YGUnitPercent,
    YGUnitAuto,
    YGUnitMaxContent,
    YGUnitFitContent,
    YGUnitStretch)
objects.description: Enumeration of unit types used for values in Yoga: undefined, absolute points, percent, auto, and intrinsic sizing keywords.

objects.definition:
YG_ENUM_DECL(
    YGWrap,
    YGWrapNoWrap,
    YGWrapWrap,
    YGWrapWrapReverse)
objects.description: Enumeration for flex-wrap behavior: no wrap, wrap, or wrap-reverse.

objects.definition:
typedef struct YGNode* YGNodeRef;
typedef const struct YGNode* YGNodeConstRef;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a Yoga node object. This header only declares the pointer types; the struct YGNode itself is defined elsewhere.

objects.definition:
typedef struct YGConfig* YGConfigRef;
typedef const struct YGConfig* YGConfigConstRef;
objects.description: Opaque handle to a Yoga configuration object, mutable via YGConfigRef and readable as YGConfigConstRef. The underlying struct is not defined in this header.
Function pointer type for custom Yoga logging callbacks. Returns an int status; receives config, node, log level, printf-style format string, and va_list.

objects.definition:
typedef YGNodeRef (*YGCloneNodeFunc)(
    YGNodeConstRef oldNode,
    YGNodeConstRef owner,
    size_t childIndex);
objects.description: Function pointer type for a callback used by Yoga to clone a node during layout when necessary. Returns a new mutable YGNodeRef for the specified child index under owner.

Represents a dimension in Yoga style values, pairing a numeric value with a unit (e.g., point, percent, auto, undefined). The unit is an enum YGUnit declared in YGEnums.h. Useful for specifying sizes, margins, etc. in the Yoga layout system.

objects.definition:
typedef struct YGNode* YGNodeRef;

typedef const struct YGNode* YGNodeConstRef;
objects.description: Opaque handle type to a Yoga layout node. YGNodeRef is a mutable handle to an internal struct YGNode (not defined in this header). YGNodeConstRef is the immutable (const) handle. Nodes form a tree, have layout state, optional measure/baseline callbacks, and are configured with a YGConfig.
Simple value type holding a width and height in float units. Used as the return type of custom measure functions for leaf nodes.

objects.definition: typedef void (*YGDirtiedFunc)(YGNodeConstRef node);
objects.description: Callback function pointer type invoked when a Yoga node becomes dirty due to changes affecting layout.

objects.definition:
typedef YGSize (*YGMeasureFunc)(
    YGNodeConstRef node,
    float width,
    YGMeasureMode widthMode,
    float height,
    YGMeasureMode heightMode);
objects.description: Callback function pointer type for measuring a leaf Yoga node under given width/height constraints and modes. Returns a YGSize with the measured dimensions.

objects.definition: typedef float (*YGBaselineFunc)(YGNodeConstRef node, float width, float height);
objects.description: Callback function pointer type for computing a node’s text baseline (ascent) given measured width and height. Returns the baseline offset as a float.
No types are defined in this header. YGNodeConstRef is referenced but not defined here; it is presumably declared/defined in included headers (e.g., YGConfig.h or other Yoga headers).
Referenced enum type; not defined in this header. Defined elsewhere in Yoga headers (likely YGEnums.h).
Referenced enum type; not defined in this header. Defined elsewhere in Yoga headers (likely YGEnums.h).

No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. It only declares the function YGRoundValueToPixelGrid. Types referenced from other headers (e.g., YGConfig, YGEnums, YGMacros) are not defined here and are therefore excluded.

functions.name: YGConfigNew
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new mutable Yoga configuration object. Use this to create a config that can be applied to one or more nodes.
requirements: Caller must release the returned configuration with YGConfigFree when no longer needed.
Returned pointer must be checked for null if the environment may fail allocations (not documented here; behavior on OOM is unknown).

functions.name: YGConfigFree
functions.description: Frees a previously created Yoga configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration previously returned by YGConfigNew.
Do not pass the immutable default config returned by YGConfigGetDefault.
Do not use config after it has been freed.
Do not call YGConfigFree multiple times on the same config pointer (no double-free).

functions.name: YGConfigGetDefault
functions.description: Returns a handle to the default (immutable) Yoga configuration with library-defined defaults.
requirements: The returned configuration is immutable; do not pass it to functions that require a mutable YGConfigRef.
Do not free the returned configuration with YGConfigFree.

functions.name: YGConfigSetUseWebDefaults
functions.description: Sets whether Yoga uses web-compatible default style values for nodes created under this configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration (e.g., from YGConfigNew).

functions.name: YGConfigGetUseWebDefaults
functions.description: Returns whether the configuration is set to use web-compatible default style values.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration handle.

functions.name: YGConfigSetPointScaleFactor
functions.description: Sets the layout rounding density (points-to-pixels scale) used to round final layout positions and sizes. Set to 0.0f to disable rounding.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
pixelsInPoint may be set to 0.0f to avoid rounding; other acceptable ranges are not documented.

functions.name: YGConfigGetPointScaleFactor
functions.description: Gets the currently configured point scale factor used for layout rounding.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration handle.

functions.name: YGConfigSetErrata
functions.description: Configures conformance/compatibility errata. Accepts a bitmask of YGErrata values to request specific non-conformant behaviors (e.g., to match legacy Yoga 1.x behavior).
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
errata is a bitmask; callers may combine flags with bitwise OR. Predefined constants include YGErrataNone, YGErrataClassic, and YGErrataAll.

functions.name: YGConfigGetErrata
functions.description: Returns the currently set errata bitmask for the configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration handle.

functions.name: YGConfigSetLogger
functions.description: Installs a custom logging callback used by Yoga for diagnostics and fatal errors.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
logger must conform to the YGLogger signature: int (*)(YGConfigConstRef, YGNodeConstRef, YGLogLevel, const char*, va_list).
The provided function must be safe to call from Yoga’s internal contexts; thread-safety and reentrancy requirements are not documented.
Lifetime of any captured state used by logger must outlive any Yoga calls that may invoke it (inferred).

functions.name: YGConfigSetContext
functions.description: Associates an arbitrary user context pointer with the configuration, accessible from callbacks.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
If context points to user-managed memory, its lifetime must cover all uses by callbacks that may read it (inferred).

functions.name: YGConfigGetContext
functions.description: Retrieves the user context pointer previously set on the configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration handle.

functions.name: YGConfigSetExperimentalFeatureEnabled
functions.signature: void YGConfigSetExperimentalFeatureEnabled(YGConfigRef config, YGExperimentalFeature feature, bool enabled);
functions.description: Enables or disables an experimental (unsupported) Yoga feature on the configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
feature must be a valid YGExperimentalFeature enum value for this Yoga version.

functions.name: YGConfigIsExperimentalFeatureEnabled
functions.description: Returns whether a specific experimental feature is enabled for the configuration.
requirements: config must be a valid configuration handle.
feature must be a valid YGExperimentalFeature enum value for this Yoga version.

functions.name: YGConfigSetCloneNodeFunc
functions.description: Sets a callback used during layout to clone a node when Yoga needs to write to it and its owner is not the parent observed during layout.
requirements: config must be a valid, mutable configuration.
callback must conform to the YGCloneNodeFunc signature: YGNodeRef (*)(YGNodeConstRef oldNode, YGNodeConstRef owner, size_t childIndex).
The callback should return a new mutable YGNodeRef suitable for Yoga to mutate (inferred from description).
The callback may be invoked during layout; it must be safe for that context and respect any thread-safety constraints of the embedding environment (not specified).
Any resources captured/used by the callback must remain valid for the duration of its invocation (inferred).

functions.name: YGFloatIsUndefined
functions.description: Returns whether a float represents an undefined Yoga style value (i.e., NaN). Use this to test if a style value is not set, comparing against YGUndefined or checking NaN semantics. Intended for validating/branching on optional numeric style inputs.
requirements: Accepts any finite or non-finite float; no special initialization required.
Returns true for undefined (NaN) values; false otherwise. Caller should branch on the boolean return.
Do not compare directly to YGUndefined; use this helper to handle NaN semantics reliably.
Callable from both C and C++ (declared in an extern "C" block).

functions.name: operator==
functions.signature: inline bool operator==(const YGValue& lhs, const YGValue& rhs);
functions.description: Compares two YGValue objects for equality. If units differ, the values are unequal. For units Undefined, Auto, FitContent, MaxContent, and Stretch, values are considered equal regardless of the numeric value. For Point and Percent units, equality requires both units to match and the float values to be exactly equal.
requirements: Available only in C++ translation units (__cplusplus must be defined).
Both parameters must reference valid YGValue objects.
For Point and Percent, comparison is exact float equality; callers should not expect tolerance-based comparison.
If units are Undefined, Auto, FitContent, MaxContent, or Stretch, the numeric 'value' field is ignored for equality.

functions.name: operator!=
functions.signature: inline bool operator!=(const YGValue& lhs, const YGValue& rhs);
functions.description: Inequality for YGValue; returns the negation of operator==. See operator== for unit-specific behavior.
requirements: Available only in C++ translation units (__cplusplus must be defined).
Both parameters must reference valid YGValue objects.
Semantics are the logical negation of operator==.

functions.name: operator-
functions.description: Unary negation for YGValue. Returns a new YGValue with the same unit and negated numeric value. Useful for expressing negative lengths or percentages. For units where the numeric value is ignored (e.g., Auto, Undefined, FitContent, MaxContent, Stretch), the numeric field is still negated but may be semantically irrelevant.
requirements: Available only in C++ translation units (__cplusplus must be defined).
Input must be a valid YGValue; the result preserves the unit and negates the 'value' field.
Callers should ensure negative values are meaningful for the target property/unit; Yoga may ignore the numeric value for non-measure units (Auto/Undefined/etc.).

functions.name: YGNodeNew
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new Yoga node using the default Yoga configuration. Use this as the root or a child node before configuring style and children and then computing layout.
requirements: Caller must free the returned node with YGNodeFree(), YGNodeFreeRecursive(), or YGNodeFinalize() when no longer needed.
The returned node is mutable and can be configured before layout.

functions.name: YGNodeNewWithConfig
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new Yoga node using the provided Yoga configuration.
requirements: config should be a valid Yoga configuration object created by the Yoga config API.
Caller must free the returned node with YGNodeFree(), YGNodeFreeRecursive(), or YGNodeFinalize() when no longer needed.

functions.name: YGNodeClone
functions.description: Creates and returns a mutable copy of an existing node. The clone copies the context and children but has no owner set. The clone operation does not invoke the clone-node callback configured via YGConfigSetCloneNodeFunc().
requirements: node must refer to an existing Yoga node.
The returned node is detached (no owner) and must be managed/freed by the caller.

functions.name: YGNodeFree
functions.description: Frees a Yoga node, disconnecting it from its owner and its children.
requirements: node must be a Yoga node previously created (e.g., via YGNodeNew/WithConfig/Clone).
After calling, node must not be used again.

functions.name: YGNodeFreeRecursive
functions.description: Frees the subtree of Yoga nodes rooted at the given node.
requirements: node must be the root of the subtree to be freed or any node whose entire subtree should be deallocated.
After calling, the node and all its descendants must not be used again.

functions.name: YGNodeFinalize
functions.description: Finalizes (frees) a Yoga node without disconnecting it from its owner or children. Intended for scenarios like parallel garbage collection when the entire tree is unreachable.
requirements: node must be a Yoga node that is no longer needed by the caller.
After calling, node must not be used again.

functions.name: YGNodeReset
functions.description: Resets the node to its default state (clears style/state to defaults).
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeCalculateLayout
functions.signature: void YGNodeCalculateLayout(YGNodeRef node, float availableWidth, float availableHeight, YGDirection ownerDirection);
functions.description: Computes layout for the tree rooted at node given available width/height and the owner’s direction. After calling, layout results can be read via YGNodeLayoutGet* accessors. YGNodeGetHasNewLayout() indicates if results changed since the previous calculation.
requirements: node must be the root of the subtree to layout (or the entry point for layout computation).
ownerDirection must be a valid YGDirection value.
After computation, read layout via YGNodeLayoutGet* APIs; check YGNodeGetHasNewLayout() to know if layout changed.

functions.name: YGNodeGetHasNewLayout
functions.description: Returns whether the given node may have new layout results since the last layout calculation. This value must be reset via YGNodeSetHasNewLayout().
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
Call YGNodeSetHasNewLayout(node, false/true) to reset as appropriate.

functions.name: YGNodeSetHasNewLayout
functions.description: Sets whether the node’s layout is considered new. Typically used to clear the new-layout flag after consuming layout results.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeIsDirty
functions.description: Returns whether the node’s layout is dirty due to changes in it or its children, indicating layout may need to be recomputed.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeMarkDirty
functions.description: Marks a node with a custom measure function as dirty, indicating that its measured size is no longer valid and layout should be recomputed.
requirements: node should have a custom measure function set via YGNodeSetMeasureFunc() when using this API, as implied by the documentation.

functions.name: YGNodeSetDirtiedFunc
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when a change dirties this node in the Yoga tree.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
dirtiedFunc must be a function pointer of type YGDirtiedFunc or NULL to clear.

functions.name: YGNodeGetDirtiedFunc
functions.description: Returns the dirtied callback function set on the node, or NULL if none.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeInsertChild
functions.signature: void YGNodeInsertChild(YGNodeRef node, YGNodeRef child, size_t index);
functions.description: Inserts the given child node into node’s children at the specified index.
requirements: node and child must be valid Yoga nodes.
index must designate the desired insertion position among the current children (must be within the supported range for insertion).

functions.name: YGNodeSwapChild
functions.signature: void YGNodeSwapChild(YGNodeRef node, YGNodeRef child, size_t index);
functions.description: Replaces the child at the given index with the provided child node.
requirements: node and child must be valid Yoga nodes.
index must refer to an existing child position to be replaced.

functions.name: YGNodeRemoveChild
functions.description: Removes the specified child node from node’s children.
requirements: node and child must be valid Yoga nodes.
child must currently be a child of node.

functions.name: YGNodeRemoveAllChildren
functions.description: Removes all child nodes from the given node.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetChildren
functions.signature: void YGNodeSetChildren(YGNodeRef owner, const YGNodeRef* children, size_t count);
functions.description: Replaces the owner’s children with the provided array of child nodes.
requirements: owner must be a valid Yoga node.
children must point to an array of YGNodeRef with at least count elements (or be NULL when count is 0).
Each element in children must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeGetChild
functions.description: Returns the child node at the given index.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
index must refer to an existing child; out-of-range behavior is unspecified here.

functions.name: YGNodeGetChildCount
functions.description: Returns the number of child nodes of the given node.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeGetOwner
functions.description: Returns the current owner (parent) of the node, or NULL if none.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeGetParent
functions.description: Returns the current parent (owner) of the node, or NULL if none.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetConfig
functions.description: Sets a new configuration object for the node after creation.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
config must be a valid Yoga configuration object.

functions.name: YGNodeGetConfig
functions.description: Returns the configuration currently set on the node.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetContext
functions.description: Associates an opaque context pointer with the node, retrievable in callbacks.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
context may be NULL to clear the context.

functions.name: YGNodeGetContext
functions.description: Returns the context pointer set on the node, or NULL if none.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetMeasureFunc
functions.description: Registers a custom measurement function for a Yoga leaf node (commonly used for text). When content affecting the node’s measurement changes, callers must mark the node dirty with YGNodeMarkDirty().
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
measureFunc must be a function pointer of type YGMeasureFunc or NULL to clear.
When a custom measureFunc is set and its measured size may change, the caller must invoke YGNodeMarkDirty(node).

functions.name: YGNodeHasMeasureFunc
functions.description: Returns whether a custom measure function has been set on the node.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetBaselineFunc
functions.description: Sets a custom function to compute the text baseline for baseline alignment.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
baselineFunc must be a function pointer of type YGBaselineFunc or NULL to clear.

functions.name: YGNodeHasBaselineFunc
functions.description: Returns whether a baseline function is set on the node.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetIsReferenceBaseline
functions.description: Marks whether this node should be considered the reference baseline among its siblings.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeIsReferenceBaseline
functions.description: Returns whether the node is marked as the reference baseline.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetNodeType
functions.description: Sets the node type, which controls whether a leaf node’s layout results may be truncated during layout rounding.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.
nodeType must be a valid YGNodeType value.

functions.name: YGNodeGetNodeType
functions.description: Returns the node type, which affects whether leaf layout may be truncated during rounding.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeSetAlwaysFormsContainingBlock
functions.description: Specifies that this node will always form a containing block for descendants (useful when external properties like transforms create containing blocks outside Yoga’s scope).
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeGetAlwaysFormsContainingBlock
functions.description: Returns whether the node is marked to always form a containing block for descendants.
requirements: node must be a valid Yoga node.

functions.name: YGNodeCanUseCachedMeasurement
functions.signature: bool YGNodeCanUseCachedMeasurement(YGMeasureMode widthMode, float availableWidth, YGMeasureMode heightMode, float availableHeight, YGMeasureMode lastWidthMode, float lastAvailableWidth, YGMeasureMode lastHeightMode, float lastAvailableHeight, float lastComputedWidth, float lastComputedHeight, float marginRow, float marginColumn, YGConfigRef config);
functions.description: DEPRECATED. Determines whether a cached measurement can be reused based on current and previous measurement constraints and results. May be removed in a future version of Yoga.
requirements: All parameters must reflect the current and last measurement modes, sizes, computed results, margins, and configuration used for measurement.
config must be a valid Yoga configuration object.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetLeft
functions.description: Returns the computed left (x-offset) position of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points. Use this to query where the node was placed relative to its containing block.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef (typically a const YGNode*) created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed on the node (e.g., via YGNodeCalculateLayout on the tree containing this node) before calling; otherwise returned values are unspecified.
The value is in layout points and may be affected by layout rounding.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetTop
functions.description: Returns the computed top (y-offset) position of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed on the node (e.g., via YGNodeCalculateLayout) prior to calling.
The value is in layout points and may be affected by layout rounding.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetRight
functions.description: Returns the computed right position (distance from the right edge) of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points. This complements left/width for certain writing modes or layouts.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling.
Interpretation can depend on layout direction; value is in layout points and may be rounded.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetBottom
functions.description: Returns the computed bottom position (distance from the bottom edge) of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling.
Value is in layout points and may be affected by rounding.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetWidth
functions.description: Returns the computed width of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling.
Value is in layout points and may include rounding to the pixel grid; use YGNodeLayoutGetRawWidth for the pre-rounding value.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetHeight
functions.description: Returns the computed height of the node after a Yoga layout pass, in points.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling.
Value is in layout points and may include rounding to the pixel grid; use YGNodeLayoutGetRawHeight for the pre-rounding value.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetDirection
functions.description: Returns the resolved layout direction (e.g., LTR or RTL) of the node after layout, as a YGDirection enum.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass should have been performed to get a resolved direction consistent with the final layout.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetHadOverflow
functions.description: Returns whether the node had overflow during the last layout (i.e., content exceeded the available space).
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling for a meaningful result.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetMargin
functions.description: Returns the computed margin for the given edge after layout, in points. If the style margin was specified as a percentage, this returns the resolved value used during layout.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.
A layout pass must have been performed before calling.
edge must be a valid YGEdge enum value within its defined range (e.g., YGEdgeLeft, YGEdgeTop, etc.).
Returned value is in layout points and may be rounded.

functions.name: YGNodeLayoutGetBorder
functions.description: Returns the computed border width for the given edge after layout, in points. If specified as a percentage, this returns the resolved value used during layout.
requirements: node must be a valid YGNodeConstRef created by Yoga and not destroyed.

edge must be a valid YGEdge enum value within its defined range.

functions.name: YGRoundValueToPixelGrid
functions.signature: float YGRoundValueToPixelGrid(double value, double pointScaleFactor, bool forceCeil, bool forceFloor);
functions.description: Rounds a point value to the nearest whole pixel based on a pixel density scaling factor. Returns the rounded value in points. Typical usage: pass a layout measurement in points and the device’s pointScaleFactor (pixels per point) to obtain a value aligned to the pixel grid. The forceCeil and forceFloor flags hint the rounding direction; if neither is set, standard nearest rounding is applied. Specific tie-breaking behavior is not documented here.
requirements: pointScaleFactor should be a positive, non-zero finite number representing pixel density (inferred from parameter name and purpose).
value should be a finite numeric value (NaN/Inf handling is unspecified).
Behavior when both forceCeil and forceFloor are true is not specified in the header; callers should avoid setting both to true simultaneously (inferred).
Return value is in points, not pixels, and may lose precision due to float return type (inferred).

Contents may be any bytes; consumers treat it as an opaque context pointer without assuming any specific format.

import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets FUZZ_PARAM_STR used in the YGConfigSetContext stub.
# The stub copies at most 64 bytes from the provided string into a newly
# allocated buffer and stores the pointer as an opaque context. Therefore,
# we should generate interesting C-string friendly byte sequences of length
# 0..64 (without embedded NULs, since FUZZ_PARAM_STR is treated as std::string
# and the harness will NUL-terminate when copying). We vary content to cover:
# - ASCII text (printable, mixed cases)
# - UTF-8 multi-byte sequences
# - Repetitive patterns and edge-case lengths (0, 1, 63, 64)
# - Bytes near typical boundary/sentinel characters (\n, \r, \t, 0x7F, 0xFF when valid for UTF-8)
# Note: We keep inputs valid as strings (no embedded NUL) and <= 64 bytes.

PRINTABLE = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation + " "

# Some useful UTF-8 fragments and sequences
UTF8_EMOJIS = [
    "😀", "😃", "😄", "😁", "🚀", "✨", "🧪", "🧩"
]
UTF8_SCRIPTS = [
    "Русский",  # Cyrillic
    "Ελληνικά", # Greek
    "العربية",  # Arabic
    "हिन्दी",    # Devanagari
    "日本語",     # Japanese
    "한국어",     # Korean
    "中文测试",    # Chinese
]

BOUNDARY_SEQUENCES = [
    "\n", "\r\n", "\t", "\\0", "\\\\", "'\"", "{}[]()<>",
    "--", "==", "::", "..", ",,", ";;",
]

KEYWORDS = [
    "context", "yoga", "YGConfig", "node", "measure", "baseline",
    "auto", "percent", "point", "rtl", "ltr", "flex", "wrap",
]

def _rand_printable(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    return ''.join(rng.choice(PRINTABLE) for _ in range(n))

def _mix_segments(rng: random.Random, target_len: int) -> str:
    parts: List[str] = []
    while True:
        choice = rng.randint(0, 5)
        if choice == 0 and UTF8_EMOJIS:
            parts.append(rng.choice(UTF8_EMOJIS))
        elif choice == 1 and UTF8_SCRIPTS:
            parts.append(rng.choice(UTF8_SCRIPTS))
        elif choice == 2 and BOUNDARY_SEQUENCES:
            parts.append(rng.choice(BOUNDARY_SEQUENCES))
        elif choice == 3 and KEYWORDS:
            parts.append(rng.choice(KEYWORDS))
        else:
            parts.append(_rand_printable(rng, rng.randint(1, 8)))
        s = ''.join(parts)
        if len(s.encode('utf-8')) >= target_len:
            # Trim to byte budget without splitting UTF-8
            enc = s.encode('utf-8')[:target_len]
            # Ensure we don't cut a multibyte sequence
            while True:
                try:
                    s2 = enc.decode('utf-8')
                    return s2
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    enc = enc[:-1]
        # Loop to add more parts

def _edge_case_strings() -> List[str]:
    return [
        "",  # empty
        "A",  # single char
        "0" * 63,
        "1" * 64,
        "\n" * 32,
        "\t" * 32,
        " ",
        "\\\\" * 16,
        "'\"'" * 16,
        "{[]}()<>" * 8,
        "percent:100%",
        "auto",
        "rtl-ltr-flex-wrap",
        "😀🚀✨",
        "日本語テスト",
        "context-pointer",
    ]

def _make_candidate(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Decide a target byte length 0..64, with bias toward edges
    choices = [0,1,63,64] + [rng.randint(2, 62) for _ in range(6)]
    target_len = rng.choice(choices)

    style = rng.randint(0, 4)
    if style == 0:
        s = _rand_printable(rng, target_len)
    elif style == 1:
        # Mixed segments aiming for target_len bytes
        s = _mix_segments(rng, target_len)
    elif style == 2:
        s = rng.choice(_edge_case_strings())
        # Trim/pad to target_len bytes
        enc = s.encode('utf-8')
        if len(enc) > target_len:
            # Trim carefully
            enc = enc[:target_len]
            while True:
                try:
                    s = enc.decode('utf-8')
                    break
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    enc = enc[:-1]
        elif len(enc) < target_len:
            s += _rand_printable(rng, target_len - len(enc))
    elif style == 3:
        # Keyword-focused then boundary
        s = (rng.choice(KEYWORDS) + rng.choice(BOUNDARY_SEQUENCES) + rng.choice(KEYWORDS))
        # Adjust to length
        enc = s.encode('utf-8')
        if len(enc) > target_len:
            enc = enc[:target_len]
            while True:
                try:
                    s = enc.decode('utf-8')
                    break
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    enc = enc[:-1]
        elif len(enc) < target_len:
            s += _rand_printable(rng, target_len - len(enc))
    else:
        # Primarily UTF-8 content
        parts = [rng.choice(UTF8_SCRIPTS + UTF8_EMOJIS) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 6))]
        s = ''.join(parts)
        enc = s.encode('utf-8')
        if len(enc) > target_len:
            enc = enc[:target_len]
            while True:
                try:
                    s = enc.decode('utf-8')
                    break
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    enc = enc[:-1]
        elif len(enc) < target_len:
            s += _rand_printable(rng, target_len - len(enc))

    # Ensure final byte size <= 64 and no embedded NULs
    b = s.encode('utf-8')[:64]
    b = b.replace(b"\x00", b" ")
    return b


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Produce one candidate buffer to be consumed by FUZZ_PARAM_STR.
    # Size limit: <= 64 bytes to match stub copy limit and ensure validity.
    buf = _make_candidate(rng)
    # Double-check size constraint and global max 4096
    if len(buf) > 64:
        buf = buf[:64]
    if len(buf) > 4096:
        buf = buf[:4096]
    return buf
